classes.client: the client of record for this engagement
classes.engagement: the engagement itself: one job, one root folder
classes.deliverable: something the engagement produces (filing, report, statement)
classes.document_slot: a named place an incoming client document goes
classes.gate: a condition that must clear before work runs; reports blockers only
classes.open_item: an unresolved question, request, or task with an owner

relations.gated_by: node -> gate ids that must be met first
relations.depends_on: node -> node ids that must exist/finish first
relations.feeds: document_slot -> deliverable ids the document feeds
relations.audience: shared | internal (shared nodes are visible to partner views)

rules: R-ID every link resolves to an existing id
R-OWN every open_item has an owner
R-AUD a shared node may not link to an internal-only node (leak check)
R-GATE gates are unmet until a human marks them met; gate_check never approves
